title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Fitness and Wellness Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a fitness or wellness app: health data, workout logging that works in a gym, subscriptions, and push reminders that bring people back.
body_markdown: Apple's guidelines let one-to-one real-time services such as fitness training use purchase methods other than in-app purchase, while one-to-few and one-to-many real-time services must use in-app purchase.
